pages.text: Ars Nouveau is the primary Tier 2 magic mod. Customizable spell glyphs, familiars, and magical automation.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Ars Nouveau is the Battlemage and Archmage's natural home at Tier 2. The glyph-based spell system allows building custom spells tailored to your class's strengths.$(br2)$(bold)Source generation:$(/bold) Ars Nouveau uses Source as its resource. Source Jars and Sourcelinks are the T2 mana automation backbone.

$(bold)Faefolk synergy:$(/bold) +10% spell power from the Nature Magic racial. Ars Nouveau's nature-flavored spells benefit the most.$(br2)$(bold)What unlocks at T2:$(/bold) Full spellbook access, Bookwyrm familiar, Drygmy for mob farming, Whirlisprig for crop automation. These become available once you have T2 stage.
Craft the $(bold)Worn Notebook$(/bold) for the full Ars Nouveau reference — every glyph, every augment, familiar guides, and automation setups.
